abort.already_configured: Device Lifecycle is already configured. Add new purchases or runtime tracking from the existing integration.

user.title: Add purchase
user.description: Record a Purchase even if no devices have arrived or been added to Home Assistant yet. You can link physical devices now or attach Assets to this Purchase later.

data_description.device_ids: Leave empty to create the Purchase before any devices exist. If selected, a physical Home Assistant device can belong to only one active Purchase.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Use Manual only for another end date.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The configured Home Assistant currency is stored with the purchase.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: For selected devices, leave empty to use the Purchase date as their initial Installation date. You can edit or clear it later.

reconfigure.title: Edit purchase

data_description.device_ids: This selector shows and manages physical Home Assistant Device Registry devices only. Manually managed Device Lifecycle Assets are listed separately above. Obvious system and software devices are filtered out.
data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties are calculated automatically from the purchase date. Manual uses the date below.
data_description.purchase_price: Total purchase price, not per-device price. The purchase keeps the currency captured when it was created.
data_description.receipt_url: Optional URL to a receipt, invoice or other purchase document.
data_description.installed_date: The installation date can be changed or cleared independently of the purchase date.

user.title: Add runtime tracking
user.description: First choose the physical device and runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method.

data_description.device_id: The Runtime hours sensor is linked to this physical Home Assistant device and its persistent Device Lifecycle Asset. Service-type HA devices are rejected.
data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

runtime_source.title: Configure runtime source
runtime_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power mode shows only actual power sensors; on-state mode shows sensible on/off entities.

data_description.source_entity_id: Power mode accepts Power device-class sensors whose unit can be converted to watts. On-state mode accepts switches, lights, binary sensors, input booleans and fans. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Prevents toggling around the threshold. Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis starts above 10 W and stops below 8 W. Must be between 0 and the threshold.

reconfigure.title: Edit runtime tracking
reconfigure.description: Choose the runtime detection method. Next, select a source entity suitable for that method. The tracked physical device is unchanged.

data_description.runtime_mode: Choose whether runtime is detected from an entity being on or from measured power.

reconfigure_source.title: Configure runtime source
reconfigure_source.description: The source list is filtered for the selected tracking method. Power threshold and hysteresis are shown only in power mode.

data_description.source_entity_id: Select a source suitable for the chosen mode. Device Lifecycle's own entities are excluded.
data_description.power_threshold: Runtime starts when the source power, normalized to watts, rises above this threshold.
data_description.power_hysteresis: Example: 10 W threshold and 2 W hysteresis stops only below 8 W. Existing trackers default to 0 W hysteresis, preserving old behavior.

asset_deployment.description: Asset: {asset}. Current location: {current_area}. Not installed means the Asset is not installed right now but still belongs to your inventory. Permanent removal, disposal or loss is recorded under Lifecycle. Installation status is independent of any linked Home Assistant device. A location that is no longer available is kept until you clear or replace it.
asset_deployment.title: Installation & location

data_description.effective_date: Optional. Today is suggested, and you can clear it.
data_description.notes: Optional note recorded only on this immutable transition.

asset_lifecycle.description: Asset: {asset}. The current status is preselected. Retired means permanent or deliberate removal from use. An Asset that is temporarily disconnected or in storage belongs under Installation & location · Not installed. Lifecycle and installation status are independent.
asset_lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

asset_replacement.description:
{result}

Replacement: {replacement}. Asset: {asset}. A replacement is always recorded from the new Asset. It connects physical Assets only and does not transfer Purchases, warranty, installation status, Runtime, locations, or Home Assistant devices.
asset_replacement.title: Replacement

change_asset_purchase.description: Asset: {asset}. Current Purchase: {current_purchase}. This form changes the Purchase link only. The warranty is the Asset's own detail, shown separately elsewhere: changing the Purchase link does not change the warranty. A previous unavailable Purchase is shown only when already linked to this Asset. Select a configured Purchase or No Purchase.
change_asset_purchase.title: Linked purchase

data_description.device_id: Select one physical device owned by another Home Assistant integration.

quick_add_from_ha.description: Choose a Home Assistant device to prefill editable physical details. The external device remains independently owned.
quick_add_from_ha.title: Add from Home Assistant

quick_add_details.description: Review the physical Asset before permanent identity is created. Suggested values remain editable, and no data is stored until final confirmation.

data_description.effective_date: Optional; no date is inferred from Purchase, installation, replacement, or today.
data_description.ha_area_id: Optional Asset location. The external Home Assistant device is not moved.

data_description.warranty_type: 1 and 2 year warranties require a configured Purchase and are calculated from its purchase date.

data_description.purchase_uuid: Select an existing configured Purchase or No Purchase.
data_description.replacement_target_asset_uuid: Optional physical predecessor Asset. Replacement never transfers Purchase, warranty, Runtime, Area, or Home Assistant relationships.

data.undeploy_predecessor: Mark predecessor not deployed where applicable

ha_relationship.description:
{result}

Home Assistant devices: {ha_devices}. Asset: {asset}. Primary Home Assistant device: {current_primary}. Related Home Assistant devices: {related_devices}. The primary Home Assistant device is this Asset's main counterpart in Home Assistant. Related devices are references only and do not affect Asset identity, details, Purchases, Runtime, entity placement, or Home Assistant device ownership.
ha_relationship.title: Home Assistant devices

manage_primary_device.description: Asset: {asset}. Current primary Home Assistant device: {current_device}. Linking, unlinking, replacing, or promoting a related device does not change the Asset ID or modify the Home Assistant device itself.
manage_primary_device.title: Manage primary Home Assistant device

add_related_device.description: Asset: {asset}. Primary Home Assistant device: {current_primary}. Current related Home Assistant devices: {related_devices}. Adding a related reference does not refresh Asset details or affect Purchases, Runtime, entity placement, installation status, or the Home Assistant device itself.
add_related_device.title: Add related Home Assistant device

remove_related_device.description: Asset: {asset}. Primary Home Assistant device: {current_primary}. Current related Home Assistant devices: {related_devices}. Devices that have left Home Assistant remain selectable here.
remove_related_device.title: Remove related Home Assistant device
